entries.name: Ammunition
entries.description: You need ammunition to make a ranged attack, and each attack uses one piece. Drawing it is part of the attack (you need a free hand to load a one-handed weapon). After a fight, 1 minute recovers half the ammunition you used, rounded down.

entries.name: Finesse
entries.description: Use your choice of Strength or Dexterity for the attack and damage rolls, but the same one for both.

entries.name: Heavy
entries.description: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls if the weapon is Melee and your Strength is below 13, or Ranged and your Dexterity is below 13.

entries.name: Light
entries.description: When you take the Attack action with a Light weapon, you can make one extra attack as a Bonus Action that turn with a different Light weapon. You don't add your ability modifier to that extra attack's damage unless it's negative.

entries.name: Loading
entries.description: You can fire only one piece of ammunition per action, Bonus Action, or Reaction, however many attacks you normally have.

entries.name: Range
entries.description: Two numbers in parentheses: normal range and long range, in feet. Beyond normal range you have Disadvantage; beyond long range you can't attack.

entries.name: Reach
entries.description: Adds 5 feet to your reach when attacking with it and for Opportunity Attacks.

entries.name: Thrown
entries.description: You can throw the weapon for a ranged attack and draw it as part of that attack. A Melee weapon uses the same modifier as a melee attack.

entries.name: Versatile
entries.description: Can be used with one or two hands; the damage in parentheses applies when wielded two-handed in melee.
